pedal: Boss BF-3 Flanger, STANDARD mode (mono: Guitar In -> Output A)
comment: Reamp: the same recorded guitar (captures/di/phrases.wav, `capture.py di`, played as hard as it was played) through the pedal at a few settings, for a by-ear A/B against NAM-X's type with the same DI and settings. Plus the sweep at Rate 5:00, which the study's 25 ms clicks saw at four phases only. Clock positions: 7:00 = fully counter-clockwise, 5:00 = fully clockwise; 9:00 and 3:00 pointer horizontal.

takes.name: bypass-di
takes.note: MODE on STANDARD for the whole plan. Guitar In, Output A only (nothing in B).

takes.name: rate-0500-clicks
takes.note: Rate 5:00 again, as the study's rate-0500 but clicks every 21.3 ms: not a divisor of the ~0.1 s cycle, so the clicks drift through every phase of the sweep.
